title: Almaty Highlights with Flights from Delhi
alt: Alley of Lovers on Kok Tobe hill above Almaty
transport: Return flights from Delhi, private transfers and private day tours

stops.name: Almaty
stops.accom: 4 nights · Breakfast · Standard room · 3★ · Long standing city hotel close to Republic Square

activities.name: Almaty city sightseeing tour
activities.description: A private tour of the old capital, taking in the Monument of Independence, Panfilov Park and the wooden Ascension Cathedral.

activities.name: Medeu rink and Shymbulak ski resort
activities.match: Day Trip to Medeu Ice Skating Rink & Shymbulak Ski Resort
activities.description: A day up the Malaya Almatinka valley to the Olympic skating rink at Medeu, then by gondola to the Shymbulak slopes.

activities.name: Green Bazaar and the Rakhat chocolate factory
activities.match: Trip to Green Bazaar & Rakhat Chocolate Factory, Almaty
activities.description: The spice and dried fruit halls of the Green Bazaar, then the Rakhat factory whose chocolate every Kazakh family grew up on.

activities.name: Kok Tobe hill and the gondola
activities.match: Day Trip to Kok Tobe from Almaty
activities.description: The cable car up Kok Tobe for the whole city laid out below the mountains, with the Alley of Lovers at the top.

program.name: Almaty
program.description: Four nights in the old capital with the city tour, the Shymbulak gondola, the Green Bazaar and the Kok Tobe cable car.

day_titles.4: Green Bazaar, chocolate and Kok Tobe

1: Flight Delhi to Almaty included in the price
Arrival at Almaty International and transfer to your hotel
The day at leisure once you have checked in
Optional: Arbat street and the Kazakh State Circus
2: Breakfast, then a private tour of the city
The Monument of Independence on Republic Square
Panfilov Park and the wooden Ascension Cathedral
A look round the Zelyony bazaar before dinner
3: Breakfast, then up the Malaya Almatinka valley
The Medeu dam and its Olympic skating rink
On by gondola to the Shymbulak ski resort
Snow peaks of the Zailiysky Alatau above you
4: Breakfast, then into the Green Bazaar halls
Horse meat counters, dried fruit and spice stalls
The Rakhat chocolate factory and its shop
Up the Kok Tobe cable car for the city at dusk
5: Breakfast at the hotel and check out
Airport transfer and your flight Almaty to Delhi

expert.name: Aisha
expert.quote: A long weekend with the flights already in it. Four nights is enough to feel you have been somewhere genuinely different.
expert.tip: A litre of water a day comes with the package. Take it, because the mountain air at Shymbulak is dry and catches most people out.

summary: Five days in Almaty with return flights from Delhi included: a private city tour, the Olympic rink at Medeu with the Shymbulak gondola, and the Green Bazaar, Rakhat chocolate factory and Kok Tobe cable car.
included: Included: return flights Delhi to Almaty; 4 nights in Almaty with daily breakfast; private airport transfers; private Almaty city sightseeing tour; day trip to the Medeu rink and Shymbulak ski resort; Green Bazaar and Rakhat chocolate factory trip; Kok Tobe day trip; a litre of bottled water a day; local guide; visa assistance.
not_included: Not included: Kazakhstan visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; extra use of the vehicle; personal expenses.
